subject: Invoice waterfall and PO trace-token requirement
messages:
From: Procurement - Helix Health <procurement@helixhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@helixhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 2 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice waterfall / trace-token requirement

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Procurement ran into two requirements on our end that we need clarified before we can issue a formal PO:

1) Our AP system needs a persistent "trace_token" field in each invoice and on the PO header so our ERP can automatically reconcile usage lines back to the purchase order. Can Redwood populate a unique trace token on every invoice line and echo it back in the invoice header?

2) For the pilot phase we need weekly micro-invoicing (small, itemized invoices) instead of monthly statements so we can allocate costs to the right BU cost centers as usage ramps. Will Redwood accept weekly invoices for months 1-3?

We attached our PO template for reference. Also, can you confirm the billing entity and remit-to information we should use on the invoice?

Appreciate a quick turnaround — procurement needs this locked to complete our Q2 paperwork.

Best,
Clara Ross
Senior Procurement Manager
Helix Health

Attachments: Helix_PO_Template_v1.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Procurement - Helix Health <procurement@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@helixhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 2 May 2027 10:03:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice waterfall / trace-token requirement

Clara — thanks for the clear note and the template. Short answers up front: yes on the trace token, and we can accommodate weekly micro-invoices for the initial ramp with a small operational setup. A few clarifying items so our finance/legal teams can confirm: 

- Trace token: we can include a "trace_token" custom header on every invoice and propagate it to each line item. Please confirm the preferred field name and a sample value format (e.g., HLX-ACC-<6 digits>).
- Billing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. / remit to: Redwood Inference, Inc., 1200 Market St, San Francisco, CA — we will include Redwood's tax id and remit details in the commercial order form.
- Invoice cadence: weekly micro-invoices for months 1-3, then transition to monthly aggregated statements unless you prefer rolling weekly ongoing. Also propose a one-time setup fee billed on the first weekly invoice unless procurement prefers to net it into the commitment.

I looped in Vanessa (legal & procurement ops), Ben (billing), and Grace (customer success) to confirm we can wire the invoices into your ERP without extra manual steps and to surface any discount / packaging impacts.

I can send a revised commercial terms PDF with the remit details and trace_token example by EOD.

Best,
Jordan
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 May 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Invoice waterfall / trace-token requirement — pricing + packaging question

Team — forwarding Helix's ask. Quick summary and asks:

- Helix requires a trace_token present on every invoice line item and in the PO header (they attached a PO template). They want weekly micro-invoicing for months 1-3.
- Commercial ask: Helix is a 3-region health system; they want weekly allocation to BU codes while usage ramps. They may be sensitive to per-invoice processing fees if we create many small invoices.

Questions:
1) Pricing/discount: If we accept weekly micro-invoicing and split invoices by BU cost centers, do we adjust discounting or minimum commitment thresholds? Helix is targeting a 12-month contract with a 200k ARR commitment. Would we be comfortable giving a 7-10% early-commitment discount if they sign within two weeks and provide a master PO that includes trace tokens?
2) Packaging/SKUs: Their ERP expects line-level SKU mapping. Can we produce invoices with SKU-level breakdowns (Model: text-inference, Embeddings, Fine-tuning credits) and a trace_token per line? Any operational limit on number of line items per invoice?
3) Ops impact: Ben — can our billing engine produce weekly, itemized invoices and embed a custom header field and line-level token programmatically? Any per-invoice fee implications?

Please reply with red/green on both the 7% early-commit discount and the weekly micro-invoicing operational feasibility. I'll synthesize and get back to Clara.

— Jordan

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 May 2027 11:05:18 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Invoice waterfall / trace-token requirement — pricing + packaging question

Jordan / team — short answers:

1) Pricing/discount: Legal and Sales are okay to offer an early-commitment 8% discount (midpoint of your ask) for a 12-month minimum committed ARR of $200k, provided: (a) Helix signs the Master Order Form within 14 days of our terms, and (b) their PO includes the agreed trace_token mapping and payment entity mapping. We should exclude one-off professional services from the discount unless explicitly added to the MSA.

2) Packaging/SKUs: Billing can expose three canonical SKUs for the order form (text-gen, embeddings, compute credits). We can add additional custom description fields for BU allocation and will emit one trace_token per invoice line. There is no hard limit on line items but >250 lines per invoice will push us into manual review — for typical Helix ramps that should be fine.

3) Ops impact / fees: Ben confirms weekly micro-invoices are doable. Operational ask: add a $150/month micro-invoice handling fee to cover increased transaction volumes for months 1-3, waived if they move to monthly after month 3. Ben — please confirm the fee wording for the order form.

Ben Carter (billing) — green for producing: weekly invoices, SKU breakdown, custom trace_token header. Hack notes: we'll need a template for their ERP identifier mapping.

Grace O'Connor (CS) — please prepare a short runbook for Helix BU mapping and the initial ramp support (account setup, tagging guidance).

I'll prepare an updated Commercial Terms PDF reflecting: 8% early-commit discount, $150/month micro-invoice handling fee for months 1-3, SKU labels, and the trace_token field spec.

— Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Procurement - Helix Health <procurement@helixhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@helixhealth.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice waterfall / trace-token requirement — confirmation and next steps

Jordan / Vanessa — thanks for the fast follow-up and for being flexible. Helix accepts the proposed terms with two minor asks before we route the PO to AP: 

1) The trace_token format: we will use HLX-<BU>-XXXXXX (e.g., HLX-NEB-001234). Please include an example mapping in the order form so our ERP mapping team can do a dry run.
2) The micro-invoice handling fee is acceptable provided it is shown as a separate line item on weekly invoices.

Next steps for us: we will (a) issue a master PO that includes the trace_token mapping, (b) sign the commercial order form once you send the updated PDF, and (c) provide the BU cost-center codes for line-level allocation. Please send the DocuSign link for the order form and confirm the first weekly invoice date (we are targeting the invoice week starting 2027-05-09).

We attached a sample PO export for the ERP team.

Thanks — Clara Ross
Senior Procurement Manager, Helix Health

Attachments: Helix_PO_Template_v1.xlsx (xlsx), Helix_PO_SampleExport.csv (csv)
